name: snagboat
description: Watches AI coding agent activity and shows token/event counts locally.

snagboat.captureContent.markdownDescription: Store a truncated excerpt (up to 500 characters) of each agent reply on its event, for hedge-language detection. Only the agent's own reply text is captured: never your prompts, tool output, or file contents. Excerpts are kept in the local event log for as long as `#snagboat.retention.rawDays#` and are never sent off-machine. For Copilot, also requires `github.copilot.chat.otel.captureContent`.

snagboat.retention.rawDays.description: Days of raw structural events to keep, counting today. Older days are rolled up into daily aggregates and their raw events deleted.

snagboat.retention.aggregateDays.description: Days of daily aggregates to keep, counting today. -1 keeps them indefinitely; 0 keeps none, so raw days past snagboat.retention.rawDays are deleted without being rolled up.

snagboat.copilot.otlpPort.description: Local port Snagboat listens on for Copilot Chat's OpenTelemetry export. Point github.copilot.chat.otel.otlpEndpoint at http://127.0.0.1:<this port>.

snagboat.heuristics.stalled.minutes.description: Warn when no events have arrived for this many minutes.

snagboat.tokenBudget.session.description: Warn when a single session's token usage crosses this total. Unset by default (no check).

snagboat.tokenBudget.day.description: Warn when this workspace's token usage for the current day crosses this total. Unset by default (no check).

snagboat.heuristics.toolChurn.window.description: Rolling window, in minutes, that tool-churn looks back over.

snagboat.heuristics.toolChurn.minCalls.description: Minimum tool calls within the window before tool-churn can fire.

snagboat.heuristics.toolChurn.maxDistinc.description: tool-churn only fires when calls within the window hit at most this many distinct targets.

snagboat.heuristics.backtracking.window.description: Rolling window, in minutes, that backtracking looks back over.

snagboat.heuristics.verbalHedge.window.description: Rolling window, in minutes, that verbal-hedge looks back over. Only active when snagboat.captureContent is on.

snagboat.heuristics.verbalHedge.minTurns.description: Minimum replies in one session within the window that hedge or self-correct before verbal-hedge fires.

snagboat.heuristics.backtracking.minRepe.description: Minimum times the same target must be touched within the window before backtracking can fire.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run build
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && node ./out/test/unit/core.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/claudeCode.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/copilot.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/format.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/eventStore.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/heuristics.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/retention.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/detail.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/capture.unit.test.js && node ./out/test/unit/transcriptDedup.unit.test.js
